featured_reviews.name: M K
featured_reviews.review_text:
For those who genuinely enjoy tasty, fresh, and authentic ice cream, Naturals Ice Cream is a lovely location.
This store, which is well situated in the center of Cuffe Parade, continues the brand's tradition of providing fruit-based, preservative-free ice creams that are distinct from standard commercial options.

Naturals' dedication to quality and simplicity is what sets it apart. Real fruit flavors are immediately apparent in each scoop, which feels rich, creamy, and authentic.
In addition to being delicious, popular choices including Sitaphal, Mango, Anjeer, and Tender Coconut taste authentically handcrafted.

The sweetness is well-balanced and not overbearing, and the texture is silky.

This specific store has a tidy, light-filled, and welcoming atmosphere. The rapid service guarantees that you won't have to wait long, even at peak hours, and the open counter makes it easy for customers to observe the available flavors.
If you're not sure what to choose, the staff is always willing to provide samples and is courteous and helpful.

The constancy in quality is another excellent feature. The flavor and freshness are the same whether you arrive in the day or late at night. It's also a great place for a fast post-meal dessert stop or a laid-back adventure.
Ice cream fans should visit Naturals Ice Cream in Cuffe Parade. It stands out in Mumbai's bustling dessert market thanks to its emphasis on natural ingredients, distinctive tastes, and dependable quality. This place won't let you down if you prefer real flavors over fake ones.

featured_reviews.name: Ameeta mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Absolute Gold Standard for Natural, Fruit-Based Ice Cream. No Contest.

For decades, Naturals has been more than just an ice cream parlor—it’s a beloved Mumbai ritual. In a world of artificial flavors and creamy overload, Naturals stands apart by celebrating the true, intense essence of real fruit and ingredients. It’s the taste of purity and nostalgia, every single time.

The Ice Cream (5/5):
This is where magic happens. We tried the Sitaphal (Custard Apple), Tender Coconut, and the classic Chikoo. Each scoop was an explosion of authentic, unadulterated flavor. The Sitaphal was fragrant and loaded with real fruit pulp, the Tender Coconut was refreshing and creamy with delicate coconut pieces, and the Chikoo tasted like the fruit itself, perfectly sweet and earthy. The textures are superb—smooth yet substantial, never overly airy or gummy. You can taste the quality in every bite.

Ambiance & Service (4/5):
The outlets are typically bright, clean, and functional. It’s all about the ice cream, not lavish seating. The queue, especially on weekends, is a testament to its legendary status. Service is quick and efficient—the staff knows the menu inside out and are happy to offer samples if you’re undecided.

Heads Up:

Seasonal Specials are a MUST-try. If Jackfruit, Lychee, or Fig are available, don’t think twice.

It’s all vegetarian and uses real sugar, not artificial sweeteners. The purity is palpable.

Be prepared for a queue, but it moves fast and is 100% worth the wait.

This is not overly rich, buttercream-style ice cream. It’s lighter, fruit-forward, and uniquely refreshing.

Verdict:
Naturals Ice Cream isn't just the best in Mumbai; for its specific category of natural fruit ice creams, it’s arguably the best in India. It represents an unwavering commitment to quality that has never faltered. It’s the taste of childhood, summer, and sheer honesty in a cup. A perfect five-star experience that never disappoints. An absolute must-visit for anyone in the city.

customer_updates.name: Gaurav Tayade
customer_updates.text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour — it’s a slice of Mumbai’s history, nostalgia, and sweetness served between two wafer biscuits. Located right opposite Marine Drive, this humble little shop has been delighting generations of Mumbaikars long before fancy dessert chains took over the city. Walking into K. Rustom’s feels like stepping back in time, where simplicity, tradition, and genuine flavor still matter.
The moment you enter, you’re greeted by a display filled with colorful ice cream sandwiches stacked neatly in their signature paper wraps. There’s no loud décor, neon lights, or Instagram aesthetic — and that’s exactly the charm of this place. It has retained its old-world authenticity over the decades, focusing purely on what truly matters: great taste and generous portions at affordable prices.
The menu may look simple, but every flavor carries its own personality. From classic favorites like strawberry, vanilla, and chocolate to more unique ones like walnut crunch, rum and raisin, raspberry ripple, and kesar pista — each scoop has a distinct richness. The ice cream is perfectly firm, creamy yet light, and the wafer adds that satisfying crunch which makes every bite nostalgic.
One of my personal favorites is their Walnut Crunch — it’s rich, nutty, and has that perfect balance of sweetness without being overpowering. The Rum and Raisin flavor, too, stands out with its mature taste and smooth texture. Even their Mango and Pineapple flavors are fresh and fruity, reminding you of homemade ice creams made with love.
What makes K. Rustom’s truly special, though, is the experience that surrounds it. You grab your ice cream sandwich, step outside, and just a few steps away is the iconic Marine Drive promenade. Sitting by the sea, enjoying the breeze, and relishing that cold, creamy delight as waves crash nearby — it’s a feeling that no modern dessert café can replicate. It’s Mumbai in its purest form — simple joys in a chaotic city.
Another reason people love K. Rustom’s is their consistency. They’ve been serving quality ice creams for decades, and despite the growing popularity, they haven’t changed their style or pricing drastically. The service is quick, the staff polite, and everything runs with quiet efficiency — just like it always has.
If you’re visiting Mumbai or even if you’ve lived here all your life, K. Rustom & Co. deserves a spot on your must-visit list. It’s a reminder that some things never need to change to stay perfect.
In a world of gourmet desserts and Instagram cafés, K. Rustom’s remains refreshingly old-fashioned — and that’s exactly what makes it legendary. A scoop of nostalgia, a dash of heritage, and a lot of happiness — that’s what every visit feels like. ❤️

The ice cream sandwiches are clearly the highlight here, and they did not disappoint. I tried a classic combination, and the thick, creamy ice cream paired with soft wafers tasted incredibly rich and fresh. The flavors are straightforward but very well done, without being overly sweet. You can tell that the focus is on quality rather than variety or presentation.
What I really liked was the no-frills approach of the place. There is no seating or fancy décor, yet people patiently line up just for the taste. Watching customers from different age groups enjoying their ice creams made the visit feel warm and familiar. featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour—it’s a timeless Mumbai experience that perfectly blends nostalgia, simplicity, and great taste. Located near Churchgate Station, opposite the Ambassador Hotel, this iconic spot has been serving its legendary ice cream sandwiches since 1953, and it truly lives up to its reputation.
The highlight here is undoubtedly their signature ice cream sandwiches—thick, creamy slabs of ice cream pressed between crisp wafer biscuits. The texture is rich and smooth, never icy, and the flavours are honest, balanced, and not overly sweet. We tried a variety of flavours including Walnut Crunch, Coffee, Kesar Pista, Pista, Vanilla, Choco Crunch, Candied Cream, and Chocolate Almond. Chocolate Almond and Walnut Crunch stood out as absolute favourites, while Coconut Pista felt slightly below average. Each flavour tasted true to its name, showcasing quality over gimmicks.
What makes K. Rustom & Co. special is its no-frills, old-world charm. There’s no fancy décor or seating—just a simple setup where people from all age groups patiently queue up for a taste of nostalgia. The service is quick and efficient, even during peak hours, though it can feel a bit rushed due to the crowd. The place is often busy, especially in the evenings and on weekends, which only proves its enduring popularity.
Prices are very reasonable considering the quality and legacy. Do note that the outlet accepts cash only, so it’s best to come prepared. There’s no parking, no photography allowed inside, and occasionally some flavours may be unavailable—but these minor inconveniences are easy to overlook once you take that first bite.
Overall, K. Rustom & Co. offers simple, authentic ice cream with a strong emotional connect. It’s perfect for a quick dessert after a walk at Marine Drive or for introducing visitors to a true taste of Mumbai’s culinary heritage. Not fancy, not modern—just classic, comforting, and memorable. A must-visit for every dessert lover in Mumbai. 🍨✨

featured_reviews.name: Merlin

featured_reviews.name: Tanmay Ayare
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. – A Mumbai Classic Ice Cream That Never Disappoints

Location - Near Churchgate Station, opposite Ambassador Hotel, Mumbai

Stepping into K. Rustom & Co. is like taking a trip back in time and every bite of their iconic ice cream sandwiches takes you even further. A true Mumbai institution, this old-school parlour continues to win hearts with its unique charm and legendary flavours.

What We Tried

We ate a delicious range of flavours:

- Walnut Crunch – nutty, creamy, and perfectly balanced

- Coffee – subtle, strong, and not overly sweet

- Candied Cream – fun, nostalgic. Kids would love it

- Pista – smooth and mildly flavoured

- Choco Crunch – rich chocolate with bits of crunch that added great texture

- Paan – surprisingly refreshing with just the right hit of paan essence

All of them were served between their signature thin wafer biscuits, making it easy to eat (and very photogenic!). The texture is dense yet smooth, and each flavour felt true to its name.

Price & Experience

Prices are very affordable, especially considering how unique and satisfying the product is. Do note: it’s cash-only and no seating, but that’s part of the charm.

Service is quick and straightforward. You queue up, pick your flavour, pay, and step outside most likely with a smile.

Verdict

K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour, it's a Mumbai experience.
If you're near Marine Drive or Churchgate, make this a stop. Perfect for a post-walk treat or to introduce visitors to a taste of Mumbai's legacy.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taj Ice Cream is one of the oldest ice cream spots in Mumbai and it makes for the perfect dessert stop after exploring the surrounding areas of Mohammed Ali Road.

We tried the Alphonso Mango, Litchi, and Pineapple ice creams, and all three were excellent and some of the best I have had.

The Alphonso Mango stood out with its rich and authentic flavour, while the Litchi and Pineapple were refreshing and well-balanced.

The texture of the ice cream is smooth and slightly denser than regular commercial brands, which adds to its appeal.

Given its legacy and consistency, it continues to remain a favourite for many. It is especially enjoyable after a heavy Mughlai meal in the area. They also sell family packs for takeaways.

A highly recommended stop for dessert lovers visiting this part of Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Kuldip Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taj Ice Cream, Bohri Mohalla ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A Mumbai institution since 1887, Taj Ice Cream is the real deal. Six generations of the Jalalji family have kept the tradition alive — no additives, no shortcuts, just handmade ice cream churned the old-fashioned way with real fruit and secret family recipes.
The Cassata is legendary, the fruit flavours taste genuinely fresh, and the humble old-school setting in the heart of Bohri Mohalla adds to the charm. Tourists and locals alike swear by it, and one scoop tells you why.
Don’t visit Mumbai without stopping here.

Enjoyed every flavor every spoon.

featured_reviews.name: Shamit Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros
1. Low Sugar content
2. Strawberry and Classic are fantastic base options
3. Wide variety of toppings
4. Deceptively filling (A large could take 30 minutes to finish casually)
5. 6th day of every month carries a one on one free offer that's a no brainer grab
Cons
1. Base options are limited otherwise. No pineapple, coffee, chocolate, saffron, pistachio, Greek etc.
2. Servings cannot be customised. Most yogurt joints have a self-serve option that charges you only based on the weight, irrespective of the toppings or mixture of yogurt types.
3. Toppings are variegated but sorted differently with respect to the price. Basic toppings like chocolate fudge sauce, Nutella, compotes are placed in the premium category.

Yogurt has become a jargon for the person who really is seeking a tasty and healthy option. Its insanely difficult to find a good yogurt joint because they sprout with marketing gimmicks and delectable flavours that are artificially concocted calorie bombs.
I hadn't outright decided to try 6th street yogurt. My friend persuaded me to join him on the 6th because he had heard about it from a mutual friend. It's easy to spot from the main road as it is just round the corner of a lane at the foot of Kemps Corner.
There are 4 offerings of Yogurt flavours. Classic with a tinge of vanilla, Strawberry, Cranberry Melon and Blueberry. On inquiring with the employee I was told that all the flavours were 100% natural. They let you taste each to make a more decisive pick. I stuck my guns with the original and mounted it with dark chocolate and walnut fudge sauce for a healthy calorie intake. To my surprise, it was actually under-sweet.
Toppings are gamut. You got Oreo, chocolate chips and other chocolate based sauces, Compotes, fresh cut fruits, dried fruits and for the more colourful- red velvet, sprinkles, M&M and many more.
The joint is small, so it's best to take the cup and amble on the pavement while taking small bites or visiting at an uncommon hour if you're interested to stay put and eat.
Coming to the big question - can this yogurt topple your other dessert options?
Well, on some days, definitely. On a normal day, you would be spending roughly 200 on the yogurt (I recommend taking at least a size up from the smallest with one or two toppings.) It can replace your midday meal with a hearty and cold delight.

We noticed many varieties of cream puddings displayed, which looked very tempting. Since it was our first time, we asked the staff which one was the best, and they suggested the Seetha Phal (custard apple) cream pudding, so we ordered that along with rose milk falooda.
As they said, the Seetha Phal cream pudding was extraordinary and super in taste, very rich and satisfying. The rose milk falooda was good, but not as special as the pudding. They also serve many other juices, desserts, and snacks.
Prices are definitely on the higher side, and most items feel expensive. The ambience is simple and nothing fancy, and the service is just okay. Overall, the Seetha Phal cream pudding is highly recommended if you visit here.

featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
A perennial favorite among locals and tourists alike, Haji Ali Juice Centre is an iconic culinary landmark nestled at the threshold of the historic Haji Ali Dargah. Since its inception in the 1960s, this bustling establishment has cultivated a legendary status, evolving from a modest stop for pilgrims into a vibrant gastronomic institution. It is celebrated for its unwavering commitment to quality, utilizing fresh, seasonal ingredients to craft an extensive repertoire of refreshments that have become synonymous with Mumbai's street food culture.
Reviewers frequently highlight the establishment's ability to maintain high standards of hygiene and flavor despite the immense daily crowds. The atmosphere is quintessentially Mumbai—a high-energy, casual setting where patrons often enjoy their treats standing on the pavement or from the comfort of their cars, adding a unique drive-in charm to the experience.
• Signature Fruit Creams: The "Sitaphal" (custard apple) cream is universally acclaimed as a must-try masterpiece, featuring a luscious, thick consistency generously laden with fresh fruit chunks.
• Exotic Shakes & Juices: Guests often praise the Mango Milkshake for its rich, creamy texture and the "Triveni"—a sophisticated blend of mango, strawberry, and kiwi juices.
• Savoury Accompaniments: Beyond beverages, the menu boasts popular fusion snacks like the Jain Pizza and the indulgent Cheese Toast, noted for its generous cheese-to-bread ratio.
• Late-Night Accessibility: Operating from the early morning until well past midnight, it serves as a reliable sanctuary for night revelers seeking high-quality refreshments.

featured_reviews.name: Sanoop ks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Haji Ali Juice Centre is one of those places in Mumbai that almost everyone has heard about, and naturally, expectations are quite high before visiting. The menu is extensive, filled with a wide variety of juices, shakes, and desserts that look appealing at first glance. The taste of the items is definitely good—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying to an extent. You can tell that the ingredients are of decent quality and prepared well.

However, beyond that initial impression, nothing truly stands out. There isn’t anything particularly unique or memorable about the flavors that would make you want to come back again and again. It feels like what you get is something you could easily find at many other juice shops across the city.

One of the biggest drawbacks is how overhyped the place feels. Because of its popularity and constant crowd, you go in expecting something exceptional, but the experience turns out to be fairly average. This mismatch between expectation and reality is quite noticeable.

On top of that, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side for what is offered. While the quality is decent, it doesn’t quite justify the cost, making it seem overrated.

Overall, Haji Ali Juice Centre delivers good taste but nothing extraordinary. It’s worth trying once for the experience, but it may not live up to the hype surrounding it.
